title: Thanksgiving Meal: Host Family Sign-Up
short: Open your home to an international student this Thanksgiving and share one of America's most cherished traditions of gratitude and belonging.
details:
Host one or more international students for Thanksgiving dinner with your family. Students are matched with host families, and many are graduate students experiencing a traditional American Thanksgiving for the first time.

Some students are vegetarian and happily eat the side dishes, so no special entrée is needed unless you would like to offer one.

title: Thanksgiving Dinner: Student Sign-Up
short: Experience American culture first-hand with a warm Thanksgiving dinner hosted by a local family.
details:
International students are invited to join a local American family for Thanksgiving, a window into traditions built around family, gratitude and community.

Sign up and we will match you with a host family.

title: Tahoe Leadership Camp
short: Our annual three-day, fun and nurturing conference that develops 20–30 students into focused, kind leaders.
details:
Kontagious' annual Tahoe leadership training camp is a fun and nurturing three-day conference designed to recruit 20 to 30 students for focused leadership development, with sessions on relationships, attitude and communication.

Participation is by invitation. Apply with the form and our team will follow up.

title: Kontagious Airport Pickup
when: Typically mid-July to mid-August; dates confirmed each year
short: Accepted to San José State or Santa Clara University? A friendly volunteer meets you at the airport and gets you home safely.
details: A free, volunteer-run service that meets new students at the airport and drives them to their accommodation.

title: RARE Leadership in the Workplace
short: Helping young professionals handle AI-era stress, burnout and loneliness with resilient, relational leadership.
details:
Rapid AI advances are changing the workplace faster than most people can keep up with, and young professionals face real stress, anxiety, burnout and loneliness about their future.

This six-week program, based on the book *Rare Leadership*, teaches four uncommon habits for staying relationally grounded under pressure and bringing stability to an organization.
